roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Bundles of permissions you assign to users. Built-in roles ship with the app; create custom roles for anything finer-grained.

drawer.lockedDescription: The Administrator role always carries every permission and cannot be edited.

scripts.title: Scripts
scripts.description: Real JavaScript, run in a sandbox at document trigger points — validate, mutate whitelisted fields, or veto with ob.abort(). Every run is recorded.
scripts.empty: No scripts yet — automate a document workflow.

drawer.description: Sandboxed JavaScript (QuickJS) — no filesystem or network. ob.query runs read-only SQL.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Scoped API keys for integrations and automation. Each key carries a subset of permissions — a request is allowed only when both the key's scopes and the owner's effective permissions cover it.
apiKeys.empty: No API keys yet — create one to start building integrations.

drawer.description: Create a scoped key for programmatic access to the REST API. The plaintext key is shown once — store it securely.
drawer.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? All integrations using it will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
drawer.revokedNotice: This key has been revoked and can no longer authenticate requests.
drawer.keyCreatedHint: This is the only time the full key will be shown. Store it securely — you won't be able to see it again.
drawer.scopesHint: Select the permissions this key grants. Leave empty to inherit the owner's full permission set. A key never grants more than its owner has.
drawer.scopesCount: {count, plural, one {# permission selected} other {# permissions selected}}

settings.title: Company & Accounting
settings.description: Organization identity, base currency, fiscal calendar and the control accounts the ledger posts through.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: How this company is identified across the app.
organization.countryHint: Two-letter ISO code (e.g. CA, US, GB).
organization.defaultLanguageHint: The language the app renders in for everyone who hasn’t picked their own in the account menu.
organization.baseCurrencyHint: The reporting currency the ledger balances in. Add more currencies before switching.

fiscal.title: Fiscal year
fiscal.description: The month your financial year begins. Everything fiscal-year-aware — reports, period close, presets — reads this.
fiscal.warning: Changing the start month re-labels every accounting period — their fiscal year, period number and name are re-derived from each period’s start date the moment you save. Journal entries and dates are untouched, but reports and period-close groupings will shift to the new calendar.

controlAccounts.title: Control accounts
controlAccounts.description: The general-ledger accounts subledgers and tax post through. Only postable (non-summary) accounts appear.

bank.label: Default bank
bank.hint: Default cash account for vendor and customer payments

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.description: Sequences that generate document numbers. Prefix and padding shown for each kind.

settings.savedPeriodsRederived: Settings saved — accounting periods re-labelled to the new fiscal year

users.title: Users
users.description: Who can sign in, and which roles they hold. A user’s access is the union of their assigned roles; users with no assignment fall back to their legacy role.
